notes.title: V1.2 - Update and a new level
notes.content:
New features :
- A new bonus level
- Message appears when the timer reaches 2 hours

Modifications:
- Fixed obstacle on level 5
- Increased the size of reset floor on all levels
- Fixed an infinite jump glitch

notes.title: V1.1 and price change
notes.content:
Hey players!

What is added in this patch :

Modifications:
- Level 5, you can't fall into the void anymore.
- The record section was updated.

Further note:

We decided to change the price of the game to 3.99$
If you already bought the game, you can refund it and buy it again.
If you can't, please contact us at sungamestudiosup@gmail.com

notes.title: Hall of Fame Challenge
notes.content:
Attention all gamers! Get ready for the ultimate challenge in Refund Me If You Can: Lexy's Story, coming to you next week. We're calling out all gamers to put their skills to the test and make their mark in the Hall of Fame.

We're excited to announce that the first player to complete a challenge will have their name forever engraved in the game. Are you up for it?

Challenge one: Be the first person to finish the game.

Challenge two: Be the first person to get all the achievements.

Do you have what it takes to be the first to achieve these challenges and claim your place in history?

Don't miss your chance to show off your skills and make your mark on the game forever. Join us for the ultimate gaming challenge and let's see what you've got!

notes.title: Recruiting beta tester
notes.content:
Get ready, Beta Testers! The countdown to the beta test of our new game, has officially begun. In the coming weeks, you'll have the opportunity to be one of the first to play the game and provide invaluable feedback that will shape the final product.

 After you've had a chance to test the game, we'll be sending out a survey for you to complete. Your honest and thoughtful responses will give us valuable insights and help us create the best gaming experience possible.

And as a thank you for your participation, you'll be rewarded with a game key for Refund Me If You Can  and Refund Me If You Can : Lexy's story upon its release. Your participation and feedback is truly appreciated, and we can't wait for you to be a part of this exciting journey with us!

Complete this form to participate:

https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSdmt_RADhpYs7T85Qcgg24FQEv35L5H7jp6P2WpIt40YFZfsw/viewform?usp=pp_url

notes.title: Beta is coming soon!
notes.content:
Attention all gamers! 
We are excited to announce that the beta version of Lexy's Story is just around the corner. 
Get ready to immerse yourself in this hardcore ragdoll platformer as you test out the latest features and gameplay. Keep an eye out for more information on when and how to join the beta, and thank you for your continued support!
